query:
WITH moved AS (
                UPDATE namespace
                SET namespace_name = $3
                WHERE warehouse_id = $1 AND namespace_id = $2
                RETURNING namespace_id, namespace_name
            )
            UPDATE tabular t
            SET tabular_namespace_name = m.namespace_name
            FROM moved m
            WHERE t.warehouse_id = $1 AND t.namespace_id = m.namespace_id
